description: This file declares the MemBackendImpl class, which implements an in-memory cache backend for disk cache operations, including methods for managing cache entries, size limits, and memory pressure handling.

classes.name: MemBackendImpl
classes.description: A class implementing an in-memory cache backend, managing cache entries, size limits, and eviction policies.

methods.name: CreateBackend
methods.description: Creates and returns a new in-memory cache backend instance with specified size limit.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Performs general initialization of the cache backend.

methods.name: SetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size for the cache.

methods.name: MaxFileSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for a cache file.

methods.name: OnEntryInserted
methods.description: Handles logic when a new cache entry is inserted.

methods.name: OnEntryUpdated
methods.description: Handles logic when a cache entry is updated.

methods.name: OnEntryDoomed
methods.description: Handles logic when a cache entry is marked for deletion.

methods.name: ModifyStorageSize
methods.description: Adjusts the current storage size by a delta.

methods.name: HasExceededStorageSize
methods.description: Checks if cache size exceeds the maximum limit.

methods.name: SetPostCleanupCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to run after cleanup.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns the current time, possibly using a custom clock.

methods.name: SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of cache entries.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache entry for a given key.

methods.name: OpenEntry
methods.description: Opens an existing cache entry.

methods.name: CreateEntry
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry.

methods.name: DoomEntry
methods.description: Marks a cache entry for deletion.

methods.name: DoomAllEntries
methods.description: Deletes all cache entries.

methods.name: DoomEntriesBetween
methods.description: Deletes cache entries within a time range.

methods.name: DoomEntriesSince
methods.description: Deletes cache entries since a specific time.

methods.name: CalculateSizeOfAllEntries
methods.description: Calculates total size of all cache entries.

methods.name: CalculateSizeOfEntriesBetween
methods.description: Calculates size of cache entries within a time range.

methods.name: CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator over cache entries.

methods.name: OnExternalCacheHit
methods.description: Handles logic when a cache hit occurs.
